usedFor: Urable holds jobs and customers, and Calendly receives a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a job is completed” in Urable, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A finished job is the moment to offer a follow-up booking link.

watchOut: “When job gets paid” in Urable runs on a schedule, so its booking link may wait for the next check.
